name: The Riveteer Foreman
description: A big, barrel-chested ogre and Riveteer who leads Eula's crew and offers her an apprenticeship with his Family.

description_citations.work: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel
description_citations.text: "An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel " by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The foreman asks Eula whether she has thought about his offer of a Riveteer apprenticeship; she stalls, saying she is discussing it with her parents.
timeline.quote: "Blue," says the foreman brusquely. "You think about my offer?"

timeline.summary: Eula takes the shift-change whistle as her chance to run from the foreman.
timeline.quote: The whistle blows, signaling shift change.
